title: job.started (v1)
description: A worker started an attempt (engine process spawned). Published by the worker host to `lean.events` with routing key `job.<kind>.<jobId>.status.v1`, AMQP type `events.v1.JobStarted`, persistent, with confirms. Consumed by job-orchestrator (queued -> running), optimizer (children), gateway SSE.

leaseEpoch.description: Live only: epoch granted by `POST /internal/v1/jobs/{jobId}/lease` before the dispatch was acked.

engineVersion.description: LEAN build the worker image runs (`Globals.Version`).
